meta.title: M-2(b): which distance on predicted frames ranks decision impact
meta.source: M-2, Spearman rank correlation of five candidate distances against the same ground-truth action divergence as panel (a)
meta.kill_threshold: pixel L2 above 0.85 would falsify the paper's premise; the distilled head below 0.60 fails its pre-registered survival threshold
meta.notes: This panel is deliberately independent of how good the world model is -- it asks only which distance ranks decision impact, which is evaluable even with a mediocre predictor. Row order is the `y` column of each series (1 = bottom) and the tick label for row k is label `d<k>`.
